contract.purpose: Fixed-coordinate architecture regression; not a physical pKa validation
contract.energy_conversion: Raw .g and PETIT .dat use e^2/angstrom. Divide by (5.98435e-6 * 310) for kBT, as defined by DelphiTools/convert and petit1.6.1/petit.c.
contract.interpretation: Engineering thresholds chosen before the runs. Occupancy tolerance is a regression screen, not a statistical confidence interval. Final stochastic microstates need not match. Any failed threshold stays failed pending investigation; do not tune tolerances to observed results.
